## Content quality checklist

For any new page or material content change, confirm all applicable items before merge.

- [ ] Primary search intent and semantic keyword/entity cluster reviewed
- [ ] Current top organic competitors reviewed
- [ ] AI Overview / People Also Ask patterns reviewed when present
- [ ] At least two defensible information-gain improvements identified
- [ ] Quick Answer is direct and concise
- [ ] Formula/methodology/assumptions are explicit
- [ ] Worked examples reproduce the calculator correctly
- [ ] Content is easy to scan with descriptive headings and short paragraphs
- [ ] Native U.S. English editorial pass completed
- [ ] Grammar, spelling, capitalization, and punctuation checked
- [ ] Explanatory copy uses active voice wherever clearer
- [ ] Relevant contextual internal links added
- [ ] Policy-sensitive claims use authoritative sources
- [ ] Visible FAQ matches FAQ schema exactly when FAQ schema is used
- [ ] Mobile rendered-page proofread completed
- [ ] CONTENT-STANDARDS.md requirements satisfied
- [ ] python scripts/content_quality_audit.py passes
